en: A long, orange vegetable that grows under the ground and is eaten raw or cooked.
ex: Rabbits love to eat carrots.
兔子愛吃胡蘿蔔。

en: To hold something and take it from one place to another; or to support the weight of something.
ex: Can you carry this bag for me?
你可以幫我拿這個袋子嗎？

en: A particular situation or example of something; or a container or box.
ex: In case it rains, take an umbrella.
萬一下雨，帶把傘。

en: A small furry animal that people keep as a pet.
ph: let the cat out of the bag
ex: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
貓正在沙發上睡覺。

en: To stop and hold something that is moving; or to get an illness; or to reach a bus or train in time.
ex: I ran to catch the last bus home.
我跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。

en: To do something enjoyable on a special day or after something good has happened.
ex: We celebrated her birthday with a big cake.
我們用一個大蛋糕慶祝她的生日。

en: A telephone that you can carry with you and use anywhere.
ex: She forgot her cellphone at home.
她把手機忘在家裡了。

en: A small coin worth one hundredth of a dollar.
ex: The candy costs fifty cents.
這顆糖果要五十分錢。

en: The middle point or part of something; or a place where an activity happens.
ex: The library is in the center of the town.
圖書館在鎮中心。

en: Completely sure about something; or a particular one that is not named.
ex: I am certain that he will come.
我確定他會來。

en: A seat for one person, with a back; or the person in charge of a meeting.
ex: She sat down on the chair by the window.
她坐在窗邊的椅子上。

en: A possibility that something will happen; or a time when it is possible to do something.
ex: This is your last chance to apply.
這是你最後一次申請的機會。

en: To become different or make something different; or the money you get back when you pay with too much.
ex: The weather has changed a lot this week.
這個星期天氣變了很多。

en: Costing little money; or of low quality.
ex: I bought a cheap watch at the market.
我在市場買了一只便宜的手錶。

en: To look at something to make sure it is correct or good; or a written order to pay money.
ex: Please check your answers before you hand in the test.
交考卷之前請檢查你的答案。

en: A solid food made from milk, which can be soft or hard.
ex: I like to put cheese on my sandwich.
我喜歡在三明治上放起司。

en: A bird kept on farms for its eggs and meat; or the meat of this bird.
ex: We had roast chicken for dinner.
我們晚餐吃烤雞。

en: A young person who is not yet an adult; or a son or daughter.
ex: The child is learning to ride a bike.
那個孩子正在學騎腳踏車。

en: A sweet brown food made from cocoa beans, eaten as a candy or used in cakes.
ex: She gave me a box of chocolates for my birthday.
她送我一盒巧克力當生日禮物。

en: The act of choosing; or a range of things to choose from; or something that is chosen.
ex: You have a choice between tea and coffee.
你可以在茶和咖啡之間選擇。

en: To decide which one of several things you want.
ex: Please choose a color you like.
請選一個你喜歡的顏色。

en: A building where Christians go to pray and hold religious services.
ex: They go to church every Sunday morning.
他們每個星期天早上去教堂。

en: A perfectly round shape; or a group of people with the same interest; or to move around something.
ex: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
孩子們圍成一圈坐在草地上。

en: A large and important town where many people live and work.
ex: Taipei is a busy and exciting city.
台北是一座繁忙又刺激的城市。

en: A group of students who learn together; or a lesson; or a social group; or a type of something.
ex: Our class starts at eight o'clock.
我們的課在八點開始。

en: Free from dirt or marks; or to remove dirt from something.
ex: Please clean your room before dinner.
晚餐前請把你的房間打掃乾淨。

en: Easy to see or understand; or free from clouds or marks; or to remove things that block a way.
ex: The water in the lake is clear and clean.
湖裡的水又清又乾淨。

en: A person who works in a shop or office, dealing with customers or papers.
ex: The clerk in the store was very helpful.
店裡的店員非常熱心。

en: To go up something, such as a hill or a ladder; or to rise to a higher level.
ex: We climbed to the top of the hill.
我們爬到了山頂。

en: A machine that shows what time it is; usually on a wall or a table.
ex: The clock on the wall says it is half past three.
牆上的時鐘顯示現在是三點半。

en: Near in space or time; or to shut something; or the end of something.
ex: My school is close to my home.
我的學校離我家很近。

en: Things that you wear on your body, such as shirts, pants and dresses.
ex: She bought some new clothes for the trip.
她為這趟旅行買了些新衣服。

en: A white or gray mass in the sky made of tiny drops of water; or to become unclear or dark.
ex: Dark clouds were gathering in the sky.
天空中聚集了烏雲。

en: A group of people who meet to share an interest or play sport; or a heavy stick used as a weapon.
ex: She joined the school chess club.
她加入了學校的西洋棋社。

en: A long outer piece of clothing with sleeves, worn in cold weather; or a covering layer of something.
ex: Put on your coat; it is cold outside.
穿上你的外套，外面很冷。

en: A hot, dark drink made from roasted coffee beans.
ex: I drink a cup of coffee every morning.
我每天早上喝一杯咖啡。

en: Having a low temperature; or a common illness that makes you cough and sneeze.
ex: It is very cold today, so wear a scarf.
今天很冷，所以要圍圍巾。

en: To bring things together from different places; or to collect things as a hobby; or to go and get someone.
ex: He collects old coins from many countries.
他收集許多國家的舊硬幣。

en: Red, blue, green or yellow, as seen in objects; or to put color on something.
ex: What is your favorite color?
你最喜歡什麼顏色？

en: To move toward the speaker or a place; or to arrive somewhere.
ex: Please come to my party on Saturday.
請星期六來參加我的派對。
